_huong_dan: Phiếu việc tạo frame cho boss Kẻ Đeo Mặt Nạ (boss_henchman_01). kind = enemy, khung 768×512 (tâm x = 384, chân y = 464; ngang rộng cho đường quét lưỡi móc ~340 px, cao đủ chỗ giơ lưỡi móc qua đầu), asset ở assets/enemies/boss_henchman_01/. Tên animation đòn = SkillDef.animation trong data/enemies/boss_henchman_01.tres (sweep, dash, ash_wave); thời gian lấy từ đòn pha 1. Phiếu Markdown ở docs/prompts/codex_frames/boss_henchman_01/ viết tay (Claude 2026-11-19) từ docs/design/MONSTERS.md mục 5, 7.4 và bảng bộ phận owner đã điền.
design_en: The masked henchman, a chibi anime boss (big head, compact body, about 2.5 heads tall): a smooth rounded dark charcoal-grey helmet-hood made of armored plates with thin glowing orange cracks, covering the whole head; a faceless glossy black visor (no eyes, no mouth) whose eye glow appears only when angry; a dark scarf around the neck; a black three-piece suit (vest, shirt and tie) under an open dark coat; ONE large dark armored pauldron on the shoulder nearest the viewer, with orange cracks; a small round emblem half white and half black on the lapel; armored dark gauntlets; black trousers; dark armored greaves and boots with orange cracks; a long tattered charcoal cloak. Weapon: a long black hooked glaive (a pole with a large curved dark blade with glowing orange cracks), always held in the hand.
refs_always: Thân đầy đủ (số 01): trang phục, giáp, mặt nạ, lưỡi móc, màu, nét viền
Pose đứng (số 41): tỉ lệ chibi, góc nhìn, cách cầm lưỡi móc
